Type.evidence_source: Interviews were conducted in the privacy of an interview room on campus at a time that suited each participant. The participants received a participant information sheet and consent form. The interviews were conducted using a semi-structured interview schedule, which included questions on suicidal behaviour (including personal experiences of suicidal behaviour, motivations for suicidal behaviour, prevention of suicidal behaviour, morality and suicidal behaviour), attitudes towards suicide in the context of different situations (i.e. suicide in response to academic pressure, unemployment, relationship problems and mental illness) and questions on help-seeking for psychological distress. All interviews were audio-recorded and transcribed verbatim.
